housing: Kansas City renters live in brick apartment buildings and older houses in the city core, warehouse lofts downtown, and houses and complexes in the Northland.

localRules.text: Kansas City's Healthy Homes Rental Inspection Program requires owners to get a yearly rental permit for each unit, and tenants can ask for an inspection at no cost.

climate: Test both the furnace and the air conditioning, look for basement water after storms, and photograph windows and siding for hail damage.
